reviews.t: Great way to keep your hot flatiron safe
reviews.x: A+ for this flatiron holder!  I needed something to keep my hot flatiron up off the counter so tiny hands can’t grab it.  It mounted to the wall easily with the screw they provide.  I set my flatiron to 410* and the plastic got warm to the touch (but not hot) while it was heating up.

reviews.t: If the Suctions Don't Stick, You Must Evict
reviews.x: Not recommended. It definitely will not stick to any surface for as long as you actually need it to. It would function better with a weighted, solid base to rest curling irons. I bought this for my wife and it is collecting dust. Good thing the thought counted!
Great price, fast shipping, suction works well and so far resistant to the flat iron being on. Fits my original chi like a glove and even my other 1" flat iron.

reviews.t: Super! Easily screwed to the wall
reviews.x: Excellent purchase! No more on the counter getting knocked off!

reviews.t: Like Other's State this Doesn't Stay Put
reviews.x: I bought this for my wife to help her keep her flat iron safe from damaging with heat and to tidy up the counter space.  I should also note that I use this stand with her flat iron for safety when coupled with a smart plug to turn her iron on and off at specific times before she goes to work.  I wanted to have her flat iron preheated for her when she was dressed for work and also to ensure she turned it off after she was done using it, as she is notorious for leaving it plugged in and worrying m

reviews.t: Works well except for the suction
reviews.x: I saw majority of people complain that the suction absolutely sucks and it does but its alright. I cleaned the area and then placed a little bit of vaseline on the suctions and they tend to stay in the area, I might have to push it down once every so often but overall I'm not complaining as it does it's job of holding my flat iron even when it's hot.

I've had this for a few months now and while it's good for holding your straightener, the suction cups don't stick to anything. I even cleaned the surfaces I tried it on with alcohol. I even tried this on a glass surface as well as a smoothed, non textured table top; always comes unstuck.

I'm a guy (yes!) that uses a Chi flat iron. I got sick of it being messy on my vanity top and this is the perfect solution! It looks nice on my vanity and is a very acceptable way to store your iron when not in use. The quality of plastic is great yet I'm careful with putting my iron in when I am done. I make sure it is cool enough to prevent any chance of heating or melting the plastic. Great accompaniment for your Chi!

reviews.t: I have to re-wet the suction cups every night to ...
reviews.x: I have to re-wet the suction cups every night to re-stick them to my (completely smooth granite) countertop, but other than that it works as described and doesn't take up a lot of space and it provides a handy place to store my Chi when not in use.

reviews.t: Its so cool.. It handles the heat so I stop ...
reviews.x: Where has this been all of my straight haired life??? Its so cool.. It handles the heat so I stop detroying countertops!  It makes me feel so salonish.  I wish it came in different colors though.  Super worth the few bucks!
Christmas present for my wife.  Have not used it but it looks like it's well made and I think it'll be a big help for her small bathroom sink area.

reviews.t: Perfect pairing for your flat iron.
reviews.x: Perfect solution for House your flat iron and having a place to set it while sectioning your hair. Protects countertops from heat damage.
Love this!  Unfortunately I thought it would fit my straightener but mine is not a chi straightener
Don’t waste your money item will not stick to anything
Keeps my hot iron off the counter as designed.
Helps, keep my vanity organized and neat

reviews.t: Suction cups not the best, but the holder is nice
reviews.x: The suction cups constantly come undone on my smooth marble counter.  My daughter has one and has hers on the mirror and it works fine.  Expect that this may or may not be a permanent suction depending where you keep it.  Either way, the holder is well balanced and does hold the chi irons well without toppling over.  It is worth the money just to protect your countertops, surrounding plastics and yourself.  I have become accustomed to just pushing the suction cups down with each use and it stays

reviews.t: Worked for a LONG time, repurchasing.
reviews.x: I bought this about 10 months ago and love it. I just started having issues with suction. I have had it suctioned to my bathroom mirror. Now that the suction has ruined I’m repurchasing because it worked so well for so long and freed up so much space on my counter. I also don’t need to worry about burn marks on the white counter. I recommend at least giving it a try. For under $10 I’ll buy this biannually if needed because the purpose works so well!

Please Do not purchase this. The suction cups stick for maybe a few minutes but this product falls off after. Unforunately it sat in the box long enough before we used it that the return window has closed but spend the little extra money for one that works properly. I believe I looked at few others on the market with better reviews. Save your self the time.

I don’t know anything about hair products but I bought my wife a new Chi, and ordered this because I thought it would help it from getting knocked off the counter.  I am now buying a second one for my daughter.  This sticks to the sink very well and holds a hot flat iron.  My wife has not accidentally burned herself since getting it.

reviews.t: Good idea, but not quite perfect
reviews.x: Well made but only 3 stars because the auction cups don't stick well to my bathroom counter top.  It does help keep my wife's flat iron off the couch yet and nearly stored.  Good idea, just needs better grip.

Purchased for my straighter which is not a chi but it works great. No more having to worry that my daughter will leave it on top of her vanity when it's hot. She loves it! The price was awesome as well.
I love this!! No more knocking my expensive straightener off of the sink! Thought I’d have to screw it to the wall to get it to hold but the strong suction cups hold it perfectly on the tile wall!
As described. Perfect for avoiding burning surfaces. My 1’ flat iron fit perfectly into the slot . A non chi brand . Deff would recommend. I took one star off just due to the sizing being small
suction cups don't even work on the surface I have them on it does have a hole for a screw. regular size flat iron are lose in the holder, but if you have a larger flat iron it would be great.

claims.text: Many reviewers say the suction cups do not stay stuck to surfaces, requiring frequent re-sticking or making the product unusable for them.
Reviewers frequently praise it for keeping a hot flat iron off the counter and protecting countertops from heat damage.
Several reviewers report it mounts easily to the wall with the provided screw.
Multiple reviewers say it fits their Chi flat iron well.
Reviewers describe the plastic as handling heat well and being well made.
